QuestInfo.name: Tears of Repentance
QuestInfo.0: The identity of the Dragon Rider has been revealed. Talk to #b#p2085003##k who seems to have something to say.
QuestInfo.1: That such a horrible thing could happen to one of the Halflingers... You kind of feel sorry for #p2085003#. Go to #bChief Tatamo#k and tell him his story.
QuestInfo.2: You protected Leafre, though now that you know the whole story, you're not entirely sure the townspeople deserved it.

0.0: Ugh, adventurer... Please... Hear me out...\r\n#L0##bWhat? How are you alive?!#l\n#k
0.1: Actually... I'm a Halflinger that was born in Leafre. Leafre was a peaceful town with a rich soil and lush trees before I was born...\r\n#L0##bNo kidding! At least, it was until you rode around on your fancy dragon and destroyed it all!#l\n#k
0.2: Truth is, I wasn't always like this. It's just that, when I was born, strange things started to happen in our peaceful little town, and everyone blamed me, saying I was born with cursed blood! It got so bad that I left town in a fury, vowing to get revenge.\r\n#L0##bYes, getting teased as a kid justifies destroying an entire town... You kind of overreacted, don't you think?#l\n#k
0.3: Argh, your words are like a slap to the face, adventurer. Yes, I know now that I was wrong! It was foolish to take revenge on my own people... Will you please tell the Halflingers that I deeply regret my actions?

yes.0: Thank you. I will now exile myself and live out the rest of my days quietly in remorse. Please return to Leafre and tell my story to Chief Tatamo.

1.0: Have you finally discovered the Dragon Rider's identity?\r\n#L0##bYes, the Dragon Rider was actually a Halflinger who was kicked out of Leafre.#l\n#k
1.1: Kicked out? Then, could he be... Oh no. The child who was born with cursed blood?\r\n#L0##bYup, that's the guy. You guys blamed him when he hadn't done anything wrong, so he responded with vengeance. You kind of brought it on yourself, if you ask me.#l\n#k
1.2: I understand. You're right. It... It was my ignorance that caused this horrible situation... I will have to think deeply upon this. Thank you.

yes.0: #h0#. I will never forget what you did for us.

npc.0: Please tell my story to Chief Tatamo.
